name: gate wording fix on a panel card: approved even when one panel reviewer balks
why: Owner, 2026-11-21 (fail open): an approve + reject panel split goes to a third reviewer of a third family, given both notes, and two to one decides instead of the split bouncing back to the agent and then to the owner. A gate file's message wording, asked for by the Platform Engineer's line, changes no behaviour: the whole panel, third vote included, must approve it.

card.sentence: Open a PR: reword the merge gate's failing-check note
card.reason: a product PR touching gate code

chain: Fleet Steward to the Platform Engineer: the merge gate's note reads "failed (tests)" and the owner's board parses names after a colon. Change the note to "failed: tests." and update its test; nothing else.
claim: Rewords the failing-check note and its test.
